Member Function Documentation

◆ addClass()

template<class T >
std::shared_ptr< T > ClassList::addClass ( )
inline

add class on buffer

Adds a new class of type T on the ClassList buffer, and finalizes the previous class. Finalize includes endianess conversion, sanity checks, etc, and it is not allowed to update previousely the class after addClass is called for the next class.
